verify.label: whether reviews exists
verify.sql: SELECT to_regclass('reviews') IS NULL AS gone

verify.label: columns of products
verify.sql: SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable, column_default IS NOT NULL AS has_default, is_identity, numeric_precision, numeric_scale FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' ORDER BY ordinal_position
